```python
def tsp_bitmask(cost):
    """Minimum Hamiltonian cycle starting/ending at vertex 0; complete graph, n>=2."""
    n=len(cost)
    if n==1: return 0
    dp={(1,0):0}
    for mask in range(1<<n):
        if not mask&1: continue
        for last in range(n):
            state=(mask,last)
            if state not in dp: continue
            for nxt in range(1,n):
                if mask&(1<<nxt): continue
                newmask=mask|(1<<nxt); key=(newmask,nxt)
                value=dp[state]+cost[last][nxt]
                dp[key]=min(dp.get(key,float("inf")),value)
    full=(1<<n)-1
    return min(dp[(full,last)]+cost[last][0] for last in range(1,n))

assert tsp_bitmask([[0,10,15],[10,0,20],[15,20,0]])==45
```
explanation: Held–Karp bitmask DP stores the best path for (visited-set,last-node). O(n²·2ⁿ) time and O(n·2ⁿ) state storage; intended for small n.
